title: cc vars
description: Variables for Unified C Compiler Router (cc)

CC_INSTALL_METHOD.description: How to install CC ('libscript_native' uses isolated version dirs, 'from-source' compiles from source, 'system' uses OS package manager, 'mise', 'asdf', 'pkgx', or 'vfox' defers to third-party tools).

CC_VERSION.description: Version of C Compiler to install

CC_BACKEND.description: Active C compiler backend routed by cc ('default', 'gcc', 'clang', 'tcc', 'custom-cc').

CC_PKG_MGR.description: Explicit package manager override for CC installation.

CC_BUILD_TOOLCHAIN.description: Bootstrap C toolchain used when building CC from source.
